heading: Ask about this home
intro: Butler, the agency's assistant, answers from this listing.
label: Your question
hint: Price, size, rooms, floor, location or viewings.

suggest.bedrooms: How many bedrooms does it have?
suggest.viewing: How do I arrange a viewing?

handoffNote: The inquiry form opens with your question. You send it yourself.
limited: You have asked a lot of questions in a short time. Try again in a few minutes, or ask a broker.
budget: Butler can't answer more questions today. A broker can.
failed: Butler couldn't answer just now. A broker can.
empty: Type a question or choose one of the common questions.
tooLong: Shorten your question to {max} characters or fewer.
unknown: The listing does not say. A broker can tell you.

answers.bedrooms: {count, plural, one {It has # bedroom.} other {It has # bedrooms.}}
answers.rooms: {count, plural, one {It has # room in all.} other {It has # rooms in all.}}

type.plot: It is a plot of land.
type.other: The listing gives its type as other.

answers.place: It is in {place}. The listing shows the location only to this level.

availability.confirmation_required: The agency needs to confirm that it is still available.
availability.negotiating: Terms are being discussed with an interested party.

answers.confirmedAt: The agency last confirmed this on {date}.
answers.viewing: Choose {action} on this page and suggest a few times. A broker confirms the time with you.
answers.viewingAsk: Send a question with {action} on this page. A broker will tell you when a viewing is possible.
answers.viewingClosed: Viewings are not offered for this home now.
answers.contact: {agency} handles this home. Call {phone}, or send a question with the inquiry form.

unknown.price: The listing does not give a price.
unknown.area: The listing does not give the size.
unknown.bedrooms: The listing does not give the number of bedrooms.
unknown.floor: The listing does not say which floor it is on.
unknown.place: The listing does not give the location.
unknown.inclusions: The listing does not say what is included.

refusals.negotiation: Butler can't discuss offers or discounts. A broker can talk this through with you.
refusals.legal: Butler can't answer legal questions. A broker can tell you who can help.
refusals.tax: Butler can't answer tax questions. A broker can tell you who can help.
refusals.money: Butler can't advise on mortgages, deposits or payments. A broker can explain how it works here.
refusals.value: Butler doesn't give opinions on value or returns. A broker can tell you what they know.
refusals.people: Butler can't share anything about other people. A broker can help with what you need to know.
refusals.action: Butler can't book, reserve or hold anything. A broker can.
refusals.injection: Butler answers questions about this home only. A broker can help with anything else.

contactDetails: Please don't type a phone number or e-mail address here. Butler doesn't use or keep them. Put them in the inquiry form, where a broker can reply.
